added.title: Director - Engineering, High Speed SerDes & Analog / Mixed-Signal (Silicon One Optics Group)
added.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/08/2026

Meet the Team

The Director will be responsible for setting up and leading a high-performance engineering design team in the US & India for Cisco’s Client Optics Group (COG) and driving the end-to-end execution of optical transceiver development for COG’s silicon-photonics–based transceiver chipsets and modules. Key responsibilities include architecture, development, simulation, diagnostics, bring-up, and validation of electronics IC (EIC) paired with silicon photonics ICs (PICs). A significant new focus for this role is the deployment of AI tools, when possible, to enhance productivity, quality, and development cycle times.

Your Impact

Product Planning

Evaluating Marketing Requirements Documents (MRDs) and providing timely responses as to the approach, timeline, and feasibility for new product concepts.
Significant participation in Cisco’s product lifecycle (PLC) process including Concept Commits (CCs), Engineering Commits (ECs) and other important PLC milestones.
Working with the COG Program Management Team to develop and maintain accurate, detailed, and comprehensive program schedules and resource plans.
Drive adoption of AI tools to enhance productivity, quality, and development speed.

Silicon Development

Oversee the design, development, delivery, and documentation of electronics ICs, and chipsets by working directly with the various team leaders to guarantee execution with predictability, velocity and quality.
Ensure the Analog Design team is following best engineering practices in the development, custom layout, simulation, validation/characterization, & documentation of the optical transceiver designs being developed.
Apply analytics and AI/ML to stimulate edge cases, optimize test strategies, and improve test coverage, usability, debug capabilities, and fault isolation.

Collaboration & Team Development

Partner with the cross functional teams like digital design, SI/PI, layout, Silicon characterization, Product Management, and Operations teams to ensure multi-functional alignment and successful program delivery.
Foster a collaborative, innovative, accountable, and inclusive culture, promoting guidelines and knowledge sharing across global teams.
Mentor and develop high-performing teams, emphasizing continuous learning in silicon development and effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

Who You Are

Experienced large-team leader who can motivate its members to successful outcomes.
Expert in the development of mixed-signal/analog electronics and silicon photonics with a proven track record of timely delivery and first-pass success.
Advocate for AI tools, with a history of driving adoption to accelerate development and improve productivity.
Skilled collaborator and mentor, committed to building high-performing, innovative teams.

Minimum Qualifications

15+ years high-speed electronics and experience including management of global teams.
Advanced degree (Master’s/PhD) in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, or related field work experience with a focus on semiconductor and/or optics development.
Extensive experience in the following disciplines:
Mixed signal/analog electronics: Drivers, TIAs, ADCs, TX/RX Equalizers, CDRs, etc.
Digital signal processors (DSP)
Optical / Photonic ICs or similar: Modulators, Photo Detectors, Grating Couplers, Waveguides, etc.
High-speed SERDES- 112Gbps, 224Gbps, 448Gbps PAM4/PAM6
Signal & power integrity, channel modeling
Advanced packaging including fine-pitch and low-parasitic chip-chip interconnect
PLL / clock domains and distribution
Power distribution
Silicon diagnostics, test coverage, and DFT
Electrical, optical, and co-simulation applications and tools
Silicon validation and test equipment

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced understanding of silicon manufacturing processes, photonics development leadership and automation
Optical transceiver silicon and module architecture definition at 200Gbps/lane, 400Gbps/lane
Good understanding of MSA standards such as QSFP/QSFP-DD and IEEE 802.3 ethernet specifications.
Strong communication, global team management, and executive presence.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

added.description:

. Minimum qualifications:

Master's degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
15 years of experience in multimedia algorithm and systems space.
Experience in ISP, image processing, computational photography, computer vision and machine learning.

Preferred qualifications:

PhD in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.
20 years of experience in multimedia algorithm and systems space.
Experience in developing algorithms and architecture that have gone through the rigors of multiple smartphone SoC development and productization cycles.
Proven track record in managing high performance teams and delivering algorithms for silicon.
Proven track record in managing high performance teams and delivering algorithms for silicon.
Deep technical expertise in ISP, image processing, computational photography, computer vision, machine learning and generative AI.

About The Job

As the Director of Camera Display Algorithms & Systems you will provide strategic leadership and mentorship to a team responsible for developing market-leading algorithms and systems for camera imaging, machine learning, computer vision, and display processing across Google SoC products. This role involves driving innovation by collaborating with cross-functional research, software, and hardware teams to invent complex algorithms, define system-level architectures, and ensure performance, power, and area efficiency in future generation products while maintaining excellence in project execution.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $281000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Lead a team responsible for developing market-leading algorithms and systems in the areas of camera imaging and ISPs, ML, computer vision and display processing.
Invent and develop complex algorithms for quality, develop architectural C-models, and specify system level architectures for products.
Collaborate with Google research teams, drive innovations, and bring state of the art algorithms into silicon. Guide your team in making technical trade-offs in selecting the algorithms and ML models.
Work with camera, video and display software teams to co-design leading user experiences. Develop IPs in performance, power and area, and ensure high quality IP development.
Collaborate closely with Design Engineering, Design Verification, and Software Engineering teams to ensure seamless silicon implementation, integration, and end-to-end productization. Evaluate video and image quality end-to-end at the system level with models and prototypes.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. added.title: Head of Product Engineering
added.description:
Position: Head of Product Engineering

The opportunity

Govineer is seeking a Head of Product Engineering who has built and shipped multiple customer-facing software products and knows how to create strong, lean engineering teams. You will lead engineers across established local government products and new experiences for staff and residents, improving the quality and pace of delivery while modernizing legacy systems deliberately. You will work closely with the Head of Product on customer outcomes and with the Head of Platform on shared infrastructure.

We want a leader who can discuss architecture and code with engineers, product value with customers, and tradeoffs with executives. You should be comfortable using AI to improve engineering work while retaining clear human accountability for design, quality, security, and production behavior.

What you will own

Lead product engineering from discovery and prototyping through launch, operation, measurement, and iteration across multiple product lines.
Build small, accountable teams with clear missions, strong technical leads, rapid feedback loops, and an appropriate mix of in-house and partner capacity.
Modernize legacy applications incrementally, reducing fragile dependencies while continuing to serve existing customers.
Define engineering practices for architecture, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, accessibility, security, and reliable releases.
Protect the accuracy of high-stakes workflows such as billing, payments, and financial reporting, with explicit attention to data migration, auditability, and safe rollout.
Deliver full-stack products and reusable APIs that work for both new experiences and existing consumers, including legacy applications.
Partner with Product, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams to turn real user problems into measurable product outcomes.
Set the approach for data and AI-enabled features, including evaluation, privacy, quality, monitoring, and human review where needed.
Hire, coach, and retain engineers and managers; create a culture of ownership, learning, and candid technical debate.

What you bring

A strong software engineering foundation and senior leadership experience in teams that have repeatedly shipped and operated customer-facing products.
Evidence of building effective teams and improving delivery without sacrificing product quality or reliability.
Fluency across modern full-stack engineering, APIs, cloud systems, data architecture, and the practical use of AI/ML in products.
Experience modernizing legacy software through staged changes, integration patterns, and careful migration rather than abstract redesign alone.
Good product judgment and an ability to work directly with customers, product managers, designers, and commercial leaders.
Clear technical communication and the ability to make difficult tradeoffs visible.

Nice to have:
GovTech, payments, financial software, or other regulated-product experience. Demonstrated product engineering leadership matters most.

What success looks like

Teams regularly ship useful customer improvements; legacy risk declines; quality and delivery speed improve together; architecture supports reuse across Govineer products.

What We Offer

Mission-Driven Work: Support an organization whose technology and services help local governments serve their communities more effectively.
Flexibility: Remote-eligible role
Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive compensation, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), PTO, paid holidays, and professional development support.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This is a primarily office-based or remote role involving standard computer work. The position requires the ability to work independently, manage recurring deadlines, and maintain a high level of accuracy in a deadline-driven environment. Regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders is expected, with an emphasis on providing responsive, professional, and solution-oriented support. Primarily office-based or remote role with moderate travel (15-25% annually), consisting of on-site engagements, team meetings, and company events. Occasional weekend travel may be required to accommodate work and meeting schedules.

EEO Statement

Govineer is an equal employment opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

added.title: Head of Platform
added.description:
Position: Head of Platform

The opportunity

Govineer Solutions serves local governments with software spanning financial operations, utility billing, payments, and community workflows. We are looking for a Head of Platform to build the foundation on which these current and future products run. You will lead the move from legacy infrastructure to cloud-hosted services, operate the production environment, and make it easier for product teams to build, deploy, and run reliable software. Your remit includes CloudOps, developer and product tooling, data and AI infrastructure, and relationships with hyperscalers and other strategic technology partners.

This is a hands-on leadership role with real ownership of migration plans and production outcomes. You will work with product engineering, security, finance, and business leaders to choose practical paths from today's systems to a more scalable platform, while protecting customer continuity.

What you will own

Set the platform strategy and phased migration roadmap, including architecture, application and data dependencies, cutover plans, rollback plans, and retirement of legacy infrastructure.
Lead CloudOps and site reliability practices: service levels, observability, incident response, disaster recovery, capacity, performance, and operational learning.
Design for the demands of public-service software: availability during critical operating periods, secure handling of financial and resident data, clear audit trails, and customer-specific configuration.
Build shared infrastructure and self-service tools for environments, deployment, identity, secrets, CI/CD, testing, and developer productivity.
Establish the secure infrastructure for AI-enabled products, including model access, data boundaries, evaluation and monitoring, usage controls, and cost visibility.
Shape platform capabilities that product teams can reuse through clear APIs and well-documented services, including integrations with legacy applications.
Own cloud architecture and commercial decisions with hyperscalers and vendors; make cost, resilience, security, and portability tradeoffs explicit.
Build and coach a lean platform team and define ownership boundaries with product engineering and security.

What you bring

Significant experience leading cloud platform, infrastructure, SRE, or engineering teams that support customer-facing products.
A record of moving complex production workloads from legacy environments to cloud services without losing control of reliability, security, or customer experience.
Depth in cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, networking, containers, observability, identity, data platforms, and modern delivery practices.
Strong operational judgment: you have led incidents, improved systems afterward, and can explain reliability and cost choices to executives.
Experience building internal platforms and developer tools that teams willingly adopt.
Working knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and the controls needed to operate it responsibly in production.

Nice to have:
GovTech or regulated-software experience, especially across multiple acquired or long-lived products. We welcome strong platform leaders from other industries.

What Success Looks Like

Product teams can ship safely and faster; migrations proceed with measured customer impact; critical services have clear ownership and reliability goals; cloud and AI costs are visible and managed.

What We Offer

Mission-Driven Work: Support an organization whose technology and services help local governments serve their communities more effectively.
Flexibility: Remote-eligible role
Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive compensation, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), PTO, paid holidays, and professional development support.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This is a primarily office-based or remote role involving standard computer work. The position requires the ability to work independently, manage recurring deadlines, and maintain a high level of accuracy in a deadline-driven environment. Regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders is expected, with an emphasis on providing responsive, professional, and solution-oriented support. Primarily office-based or remote role with moderate travel (15-25% annually), consisting of on-site engagements, team meetings, and company events. Occasional weekend travel may be required to accommodate work and meeting schedules.

added.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
added.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...The Senior Manager, Software Engineering leads the execution and evolution of large-scale payment platforms across multiple engineering teams. This role owns delivery, architecture, operational excellence, and technical strategy for highly available distributed systems while ensuring alignment with business priorities and roadmap commitments. The leader drives cloud-native engineering, DevOps, automation, observability, cost optimization, and payment-platform resiliency while guiding architectural decisions and engineering standards. The role also develops engineering talent, manages cross-functional stakeholder relationships, and ensures payment solutions meet scalability, security, compliance, performance, and reliability expectations in a complex, regulated transaction environment. About the team: The UPP Payments team builds and operates a scalable, fault-tolerant payments platform that supports enterprise transaction processing. The team works across cloud-native architecture, payment routing, resiliency, certification, security, and observability to deliver reliable payment experiences at scale. Engineers design intelligent routing, failover, and recovery capabilities that maintain stability during peak traffic and downstream disruptions. The team values strong technical ownership, engineering rigor, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while partnering across product, business, security, and payment ecosystems to expand platform capabilities across markets and support evolving business priorities. What you'll do:

Lead platform-level execution for highly available, distributed payment systems aligned with business priorities and roadmap milestones.
Drive architecture for payment processing, transaction routing, authorization, retries, reversals, fallback, and resiliency.
Oversee cloud infrastructure, shared tooling, DevOps, CI/CD, automation, telemetry, and production readiness across multiple teams.
Partner with product, architecture, security, operations, and payment stakeholders to deliver complex initiatives while meeting compliance and certification requirements.
Guide architectural decisions for scalability, fault tolerance, performance, security, and cost optimization.
Mentor engineers, strengthen technical ownership, lead operational improvements, and establish metrics for availability, transaction success, latency, recovery, and platform health.

What you'll bring:

Proven engineering leadership experience delivering large-scale, highly available distributed platforms in payments, fintech, retail, or transaction-intensive environments.
Strong understanding of the payment lifecycle, including authorization, capture, reversal, refund, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling.
Experience with payment routing, orchestration, failover, idempotency, gateways, processors, acquirers, issuers, card networks, tokenization, and PCI DSS.

added.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Member Experience
added.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.
Job Overview:
We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to own a significant piece of Omada's Member-facing surface. You own what gets built, in what order, and how the people building it grow.
A squad owns problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on-call rotation for what it ships. At this level you own more than one, which means the hardest calls you make are the ones about where capacity goes when two good things want it at the same time.
You stay technical. You are in the codebase and in the same agent workflows your builders use, close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Where you manage directly, you ship production work off the critical path. Where you manage through someone else, that person's growth is your work product.
You partner with Product Strategists who spend their time in front of members, coaches, and stakeholders, and who prototype to test ideas quickly. They own what gets built and why. You own whether it can be delivered, at what cost, and by when, and you are senior enough that your answer shapes the roadmap rather than just responding to it.
About you:
You are comfortable being accountable for what your squads ship. You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agent workflows as your squads, so you feel the friction your people feel first-hand.
You have a point of view on where AI-assisted development helps and where it creates rework, and it comes from changing how a real team works, not from reading about it. You have done the engineering manager job well enough that you can teach it. Whether or not you have carried the title of manager-of-managers, you have grown someone into leading, and you know the difference between doing the work for them and raising their ceiling.
Your first team is your peer group, not your reports. When something is slowing down the engineering org and it is nobody's job, you have a track record of picking it up, getting the right people in the room, and finishing it.

What you'll be doing:
Own delivery across your squads.
Sprint shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation. Make the calls, write them down, and be accountable for them. When two squads want the same thing at the same time, you are the one who decides.
Own cycle time.
Yours to improve, not at the expense of quality, and yours to explain when it changes, including why one of your squads is slower than the other.
Stay technical.
On squads you manage directly, you ship production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same agent workflows your builders use. On squads that run through a manager, you stay close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Either way, you can teach someone to navigate the system, not just navigate it yourself.
Partner with your Product Strategist.
  They own what the squad builds; you hold the line between their scope and yours so the squad never has two people answering the same question differently.
Grow a manager.
If an EM reports to you, their growth is your work product. Their squad's health is the evidence.
Plan the team you need next year, not just this quarter.
Headcount, skill mix, and the onboarding path that gets a new builder productive in an agent-heavy codebase in weeks rather than months. 
Set the AI standard past your own boundary.
Write down what good looks like, teach it, and measure whether it stuck. Other squads should be able to use what you built without you in the room.
Take on the problem that is nobody's.
You will find things that slow down engineering broadly. Some of them you should pick up, organize, and close out with your peers.

What you need for this role:
8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers directly.
Experience developing another leader: a manager who reported to you, or an engineer you grew into a tech lead or EM role with real accountability attached. Tell us where they are now.
A track record shipping mission-critical software to production, and living with it afterwards. We all make mistakes; what sets you apart is that you own yours and turn them into something better.
Experience owning prioritization and estimation for a team, including saying no, not now, and explaining why.
Experience giving direct developmental feedback, and at least one case where you managed someone through underperformance with real support attached.
Currently shipping, or recently shipping, production code in at least one layer of our stack (backend (Ruby, Python, ...), web frontends (React), iOS, or Android,) with enough range to follow the conversation in the others and review architecture decisions critically.
Comfort with an expert-generalist team model, where a backend-heavy builder ships in the mobile app and a mobile-heavy one ships in the backend.  You understand how transformative this model is, and you should be able to name the risks and opportunities it brings.
Hands-on experience directing AI agents through real world production changes, and a considered view on where they help and where they produce work someone else has to redo.
Understanding of CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and telemetry, at the level where you can tell whether your squad's operational story checks out or falls short.
Excellent written communication.  Much of this job is writing things down clearly once so they do not have to be argued four times.

Technologies we use:
Ruby on Rails, Python (Flask, FastAPI), React, native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), PostgreSQL, GraphQL, AWS (RDS, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab, Datadog, PagerDuty.
Benefits:

Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
Equity grants
Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
Remote first work from home culture
Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
Generous parental leave
Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
401k retirement savings plan
Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
Mental Health Support Solutions
...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!
Cultivate Trust.
We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
Seek Context.
We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
Act Boldly.
We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
Deliver Results.
We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
Succeed Together.
We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together. 
Remember Why We’re Here.
We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health:
Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

With a portfolio of over 300 products, Google Cloud powers the world's most innovative businesses. The advent of our Gemini foundational models presents a once-in-a-generation opportunity to reshape how software is built and run, and your mission is to make Google Cloud the default place where developers, and increasingly agents, deploy code.

Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

added.title: Director - AI Engineering - Enterprise AI Platforms
added.description:
Job Description

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The Enterprise AI Platform organization builds foundational capabilities that enable teams across American Express to develop and scale AI/ML and Generative AI products and experiences securely and responsibly.

Our team brings together talent and experience from Big Tech, AI research and academia, startups, and American Express, combining deep expertise and diverse perspectives with an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for building. Together, we are focused on enabling American Express to operate as an AI-powered enterprise and deliver measurable business impact.

At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise.

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services.

We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow.

Responsibilities

As a Director of AI Engineering – Agentic AI, you will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of agentic AI systems across Amex Technology. You will be responsible for building and leading high-performing engineering teams that define how agentic AI solutions are designed, built, and operated at scale across the enterprise.

This role combines deep technical leadership with people leadership. You will set technical direction, establish architectural standards, and ensure delivery of reliable, scalable agentic AI platforms—while also hiring, developing, and managing engineering talent. Your impact will come from shaping long-term strategy, cultivating strong engineering culture, and enabling teams to turn ambiguity into production-grade systems.

You will operate at the intersection of vision and execution: guiding system design, reviewing critical architectures, partnering on complex technical decisions, and ensuring engineering excellence across multiple teams. While you may engage in hands-on technical discussions, your primary focus will be organizational leadership, technical oversight, and execution at scale rather than individual contribution.

You will work closely with Product, UX, and enterprise stakeholders to shape the vision and roadmap for agentic AI experiences. Product teams own prioritization, but as a Director you will influence investment strategy, platform direction, and cross-team integration to ensure cohesive, enterprise-ready solutions.

What You’ll Do

Drive technical direction for agentic AI initiatives, influencing architecture patterns, autonomy boundaries, and system design.
Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems used across multiple products.
Own and evolve shared agentic AI capabilities, including:
Agent frameworks and orchestration layers
Planning, tool use, and memory strategies
Retrieval and grounding (RAG) pipelines
LLM infrastructure, inference, and model gateways
Evaluation, observability, and safety tooling for autonomous systems
Lead technical design reviews and help teams navigate tradeoffs involving autonomy, safety, reliability, scalability, and cost.
Partner across teams to deliver complex, cross-cutting agentic AI initiatives from concept to production.
Evaluate emerging models, techniques, and agentic patterns and translate them into practical, enterprise-ready improvements.
Demonstrate accountability while leading people with passion, enthusiasm, loyalty and integrity. Own and lead HR processes such as performance reviews, talent development, etc.
Recruit top talent with technical skills, growth potential, design sensibility, and emotional intelligence.
Lead teams in iterative product development using lean principles.
Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for agentic AI development through example and influence.

Technical Environment

We don’t hire to a narrow checklist, but candidates should be comfortable operating in a modern, enterprise-scale engineering environment with a strong emphasis on agentic AI.

Core engineering stack

Languages: Python, Java, Go, TypeScript
APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka
Orchestration Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AirFlow, etc.

Agentic AI and ML

Integration of commercial and open-source LLMs into agentic workflows
Agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, with strong judgment about when to use frameworks versus building lighter-weight primitives
Model-level work using PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (embeddings, fine-tuning, inference tooling), with some exposure to TensorFlow
Strong schema, validation, and state management practices using tools such as Pydantic (Python) and Zod (TypeScript)
Across all systems, we emphasize evaluation, observability, safety, and reliability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a regulated, customer-facing environment.
Across all systems, we emphasize evaluation, observability, safety, and reliability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a regulated, customer-facing environment.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems + strong experience with LLM systems, agentic workflows or advanced ML infrastructure
Strong experience leading and growing teams of fellow engineers through complex deliveries
A history of taking projects through the entire software development lifecycle from inception to delivery as a technical leader
Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing technical professionals.
Ability to lead engineering teams and negotiate or influence across organizational boundaries.
Proven ownership of complex, cross-cutting agentic systems spanning multiple teams or products.
Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Deep experience across the agentic AI stack, including planning, tool use, memory, and evaluation.
Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and translating them into shipped, reliable autonomous systems.
Ability to influence technical direction and align teams without formal authority.
Experience in workflow engines, async processing, queues, and streaming systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building agentic systems in fintech or other regulated industries.
Experience as a founding engineer or early technical leader in AI-driven products.
Demonstrated success delivering technically complex autonomous systems that customers actively rely on.
Meaningful contributions to open-source AI or agentic frameworks.
Familiarity with fine-tuning, model optimization and inference pipelines is a plus

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

Job Description

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The Enterprise AI Platform organization builds foundational capabilities that enable teams across American Express to develop and scale AI/ML and Generative AI products and experiences securely and responsibly.

Our team brings together talent and experience from Big Tech, AI research and academia, startups, and American Express, combining deep expertise and diverse perspectives with an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for building. Together, we are focused on enabling American Express to operate as an AI-powered enterprise and deliver measurable business impact.

At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise.

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services.

We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow.

Responsibilities

As a Director of AI Engineering – Agentic AI, you will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of agentic AI systems across Amex Technology. You will be responsible for building and leading high-performing engineering teams that define how agentic AI solutions are designed, built, and operated at scale across the enterprise.

This role combines deep technical leadership with people leadership. You will set technical direction, establish architectural standards, and ensure delivery of reliable, scalable agentic AI platforms—while also hiring, developing, and managing engineering talent. Your impact will come from shaping long-term strategy, cultivating strong engineering culture, and enabling teams to turn ambiguity into production-grade systems.

You will operate at the intersection of vision and execution: guiding system design, reviewing critical architectures, partnering on complex technical decisions, and ensuring engineering excellence across multiple teams. While you may engage in hands-on technical discussions, your primary focus will be organizational leadership, technical oversight, and execution at scale rather than individual contribution.

You will work closely with Product, UX, and enterprise stakeholders to shape the vision and roadmap for agentic AI experiences. Product teams own prioritization, but as a Director you will influence investment strategy, platform direction, and cross-team integration to ensure cohesive, enterprise-ready solutions.

What You’ll Do

Drive technical direction for agentic AI initiatives, influencing architecture patterns, autonomy boundaries, and system design.
Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems used across multiple products.
Own and evolve shared agentic AI capabilities, including:
Agent frameworks and orchestration layers
Planning, tool use, and memory strategies
Retrieval and grounding (RAG) pipelines
LLM infrastructure, inference, and model gateways
Evaluation, observability, and safety tooling for autonomous systems
Lead technical design reviews and help teams navigate tradeoffs involving autonomy, safety, reliability, scalability, and cost.
Partner across teams to deliver complex, cross-cutting agentic AI initiatives from concept to production.
Evaluate emerging models, techniques, and agentic patterns and translate them into practical, enterprise-ready improvements.
Demonstrate accountability while leading people with passion, enthusiasm, loyalty and integrity. Own and lead HR processes such as performance reviews, talent development, etc.
Recruit top talent with technical skills, growth potential, design sensibility, and emotional intelligence.
Lead teams in iterative product development using lean principles.
Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for agentic AI development through example and influence.

Technical Environment

We don’t hire to a narrow checklist, but candidates should be comfortable operating in a modern, enterprise-scale engineering environment with a strong emphasis on agentic AI.

Core engineering stack

Languages: Python, Java, Go, TypeScript
APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka
Orchestration Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AirFlow, etc.

Agentic AI and ML

Integration of commercial and open-source LLMs into agentic workflows
Agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, with strong judgment about when to use frameworks versus building lighter-weight primitives
Model-level work using PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (embeddings, fine-tuning, inference tooling), with some exposure to TensorFlow
Strong schema, validation, and state management practices using tools such as Pydantic (Python) and Zod (TypeScript)
Across all systems, we emphasize evaluation, observability, safety, and reliability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a regulated, customer-facing environment.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems + strong experience with LLM systems, agentic workflows or advanced ML infrastructure
Strong experience leading and growing teams of fellow engineers through complex deliveries
A history of taking projects through the entire software development lifecycle from inception to delivery as a technical leader
Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing technical professionals.
Ability to lead engineering teams and negotiate or influence across organizational boundaries.
Proven ownership of complex, cross-cutting agentic systems spanning multiple teams or products.
Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Deep experience across the agentic AI stack, including planning, tool use, memory, and evaluation.
Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and translating them into shipped, reliable autonomous systems.
Ability to influence technical direction and align teams without formal authority.
Experience in workflow engines, async processing, queues, and streaming systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building agentic systems in fintech or other regulated industries.
Experience as a founding engineer or early technical leader in AI-driven products.
Demonstrated success delivering technically complex autonomous systems that customers actively rely on.
Meaningful contributions to open-source AI or agentic frameworks.
Familiarity with fine-tuning, model optimization and inference pipelines is a plus

Depending on factors such as business unit requirements, the nature of the position, cost and applicable laws, American Express may provide visa sponsorship for certain positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salaries
Bonus incentives
6% Company Match on retirement savings plan
Free financial coaching and financial well-being support
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits
Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacy
Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
Career development and training opportunities

For a full list of Team Amex benefits, visit our Colleague Benefits Site .

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. American Express will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. For positions covered by federal and/or state banking regulations, American Express will comply with such regulations as it relates to the consideration of applicants with criminal convictions.

We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That's why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.

added.description:
About This Opportunity

We're seeking senior technology leaders: CTO, CIO, Chief AI Officer, Head of AI/ML Platform, Chief Data Officer or equivalent, at VP level or above with budget authority, at Global 2000 enterprise companies and government agencies.

We are seeking leaders that have evaluated and purchased open-weight AI models or related post-training and deployment services, particularly for coding and software engineering.

We require past experience in defining model strategy for your enterprise, choosing between proprietary, open-weight and internal models, and selecting vendors. Relevant sectors include financial services, government, healthcare and life sciences, technology and telecom, industrials and aerospace, and consumer and retail.

Engagements are paid, confidential 60 minute expert calls. The calls cover prevalent industry practices in adoption of open-weight AI models, what drives vendor selection, and how you expect the market to evolve.
